description: This PHP source file defines an API class `EmploymentStatusAPI` within the OrangeHRM system, providing CRUD operations for managing employment statuses via REST endpoints, including get, list, create, update, and delete functionalities. It uses annotations for API documentation and encapsulates validation, service interactions, and data transformations.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing CRUD operations for Employment Status entities, including methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employment statuses, with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmploymentStatusService instance used for business logic related to employment statuses.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Employment Status by ID, returning it wrapped in an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring 'id' parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all employment statuses, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validation rules for listing employment statuses, including filters and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Employment Status entity with data from the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating an employment status, primarily validating the 'name' property.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Employment Status identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an employment status, including ensuring 'name' is unique and valid.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Helper method to generate validation rules for the 'name' property, optionally enforcing uniqueness.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Sets the 'name' property from request parameters and saves the EmploymentStatus entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes employment statuses with specified IDs, returning the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, ensuring IDs are provided.
